# BILL-001, with a `breakdown:` block written under the bill instead of under its line.
#
# The bill side of `an_invoice_with_a_breakdown_block_outside_its_lines.txt`:
# nothing reads a `breakdown:` block under the bill itself.
#
# What this fixture produces: nothing. The bill is refused.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_a_record_block_is_read_whole.py.
vendor "V001"
	name: "Supplier"
	currency: CAD

bill "BILL-001"
	vendor_id: "V001"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-01-01
	entry:
		date: 2026-01-01
		description: "Supplies"
		account: "Expenses:Supplies"
		quantity: 1
		price: 50
		taxable: true
		tax_included: false
	breakdown:
		account: "Liabilities:Accounts Payable"
		rate: 5
		amount: 2.50
	posted: none
	payment: none
